blocks.text: The Human Resource (HR) Policy of Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation establishes the principles, standards, and procedures for recruiting, developing, managing, and retaining employees while promoting a professional, ethical, and inclusive work environment.
blocks.html:
The Human Resource (HR) Policy of Shree Shyam Small Growth Foundation establishes
                    the principles, standards, and procedures for recruiting, developing, managing, and
                    retaining employees while promoting a professional, ethical, and inclusive work environment.

blocks.text: This policy applies to all permanent employees, contractual staff, probationary employees, temporary staff, consultants, interns, volunteers, and field staff working with the Foundation.
